aurora.zh: T 方最常用警家烟、B连接烟和 B后点火爆弹 B 点，5 次赢下 4 次。进攻开始后 CT 及时回防占 20%，低于其他队伍的 48%。
aurora.en: The go-to B execute uses CT smoke, Palace smoke and a Back B molotov, winning 4 of 5 attempts. CT rotations arrive in time in 20% of rounds versus 48% for other teams.

betboom.zh: CT 堆点防守占 26%，高于其他队伍的 8%。
betboom.en: The CT side stacks a site in 26% of gun rounds versus 8% for other teams.

falcons.zh: T 方最常用警家烟、B连接烟和 B后点火爆弹 B 点，25 次赢下 17 次。T 方最常由 NiKo 摸边，22 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
falcons.en: The go-to B execute uses CT smoke, Palace smoke and a Back B molotov, winning 17 of 25 attempts. NiKo is the usual T lurker, on the other side or far from the hit on 22 attacks.

flyquest.zh: T 方最常用天堂烟、A连接烟、天堂侧 A包点火、包点出口的 A连接火和喷泉火爆弹 A 点，4 次赢下 3 次。
flyquest.en: The go-to A execute uses Heaven and A connector smokes, A site molotov on the Heaven side, A connector molotov at the site exit and Fountain molotov, winning 3 of 4 attempts.

furia.zh: T 方快攻占 27%，高于其他队伍的 12%。T 方分兵进点占 88%，高于其他队伍的 60%。
furia.en: Fast hits account for 27% of T gun rounds versus 12% for other teams. The T side uses split hits on 88% of attacks versus 60% for other teams.

fut-esports.zh: T 方快攻占 33%，高于其他队伍的 12%。CT 开局有人前压的回合占 32%，高于其他队伍的 14%。
fut-esports.en: Fast hits account for 33% of T gun rounds versus 12% for other teams. The CT side pushes early in 32% of gun rounds versus 14% for other teams.

g2.zh: T 方快攻占 30%，高于其他队伍的 12%。T 方分兵进点占 29%，低于其他队伍的 62%。
g2.en: Fast hits account for 30% of T gun rounds versus 12% for other teams. The T side uses split hits on 29% of attacks versus 62% for other teams.

mibr.zh: MIBR 的 CT 默认站位 A2 M1 B2 覆盖 52% 的枪局，胜率 91%，是队伍最常用且胜率很高的防守布局。
mibr.en: MIBR's default CT setup A2 M1 B2 covers 52% of gun rounds with a 91% win rate, making it the team's most-used and highly effective defensive setup.

natus-vincere.zh: T 方拖后进攻占 57%，高于其他队伍的 36%。T 方最常用B连接烟和 B后点火爆弹 B 点，7 次赢下 7 次。
natus-vincere.en: Late hits account for 57% of T gun rounds versus 36% for other teams. The go-to B execute uses Palace smoke and a Back B molotov, winning 7 of 7 attempts.

pain.zh: paiN 的 CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2 占 37% 的枪局，胜率 57%，是队伍最常用的防守布局。
pain.en: paiN's default CT setup A1 M2 B2 is used in 37% of gun rounds with a 57% win rate, making it the team's most common defensive setup.

spirit.zh: T 方最常由 zont1x 摸边，7 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。开局 20 秒的 CT 默认站位为 A2 M1 B2，占 33% 的枪局，胜率 60%。
spirit.en: zont1x is the usual T lurker, on the other side or far from the hit on 7 attacks. At 20 s, the default CT setup is A2 M1 B2, used in 33% of gun rounds with a win rate of 60%.

tyloo.zh: T 方拖后进攻占 10%，低于其他队伍的 39%。开局 20 秒的 CT 默认站位为 A2 M1 B2，占 40% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
tyloo.en: Late hits account for 10% of T gun rounds versus 39% for other teams. At 20 s, the default CT setup is A2 M1 B2, used in 40% of gun rounds with a win rate of 67%.

vitality.zh: T 方最常用警家烟、B连接烟和 B后点火爆弹 B 点，5 次赢下 4 次。
vitality.en: The go-to B execute uses CT smoke, Palace smoke and a Back B molotov, winning 4 of 5 attempts.
